notRequested.note: zara.com is listed in SUPPORTED_STORES.md under "Refused or not scrapeable (not retried)". Not called.
SUPPORTED_STORES.md: Hollister and Abercrombie & Fitch show the headless browser a "Client Challenge" bot check. Not called.
https://www.uniqlo.com/ca/en/men/tops/t-shirts returned HTTP 403 Access Denied on 2026-11-13 and was not retried. Product addresses come from the sitemap.

https://www.gymshark.com/products.json returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-13 and was not retried. Product addresses come from the sitemap. /collections/*/products is disallowed by robots.txt and was not requested.
https://www.llbean.com/robots.txt answered with a WAF denial page on 2026-11-14. Not retried, and no product page was requested.

sku_reviews.author: Will
sku_reviews.title: Wham but not too wham
sku_reviews.body: This one's a zinger: material is lovely & the fit makes you look wham but in a relaxed kind of way. Great for a leg day when the monster delts or carnivore chest are not the focus, a rest day, or my favourite: a chest day when you don't want to look yolked and then you casually bang out 5 reps of 110kg on the bench. You'll definitely get some Gym Broski Brownie Points in this bad boy. Requirements for this tee, however, are a minimum of 100kg on bench or a recently broken heart, so that you can pair this number with an oversized hoodie, which you'll then slide off after a warmup and your first working set, having obviously worn it the whole time with the hood firmly up and noise-cancelling AirPods in. With the Gymshark Essential Oversized Rose Brown tee now exposed for all to see under the hoodie, you'll be getting so many 'bro who hurt you?' questions because you'll look like the most nonchalant guy in there, yet really you could easily rip the weight of their whole family combined off the ground with your chest facing forwards and your glutes pointed out in a controlled manner - both parties in the conversation know this without question. Overall though, this tee is a mazzalini (Italian for 'mazzalini') and I find the dark coral colour to be very flattering, pairing nicely with the 25kg plates I stack on each side of the barbell for one-armed curls.

sku_reviews.title: Great workout shirt, just one downside
sku_reviews.body: This is a solid gym t-shirt. The fit is slim & flattering, especially with the seam lines that highlight your shape. The material is super light, doesn’t stick to the body, and lets you move freely during any workout. It also dries fast, which is great when you're training hard. The overall design looks clean & modern — simple but sharp. The only downside is the polyester. If the shirt sits folded for a while (like in storage), it tends to get deep creases that don’t go away easily - you’ll need to put in some effort to smooth them out. Still, if you’re after a functional & stylish workout top, this one definitely delivers.

sku_reviews.author: Mike65
sku_reviews.title: Do not buy - terrible cut. Shoulders pointy.
sku_reviews.body: Absolutely awful t-shirt. I should have read the reviews first. The cut of the shoulders is terrible, and the shirt looks like it has built in shoulder pads which peak above the tip of the shoulder. I put the shirt through the wash hoping this would fix it, but it's just a terrible cut. I would NOT wear this shirt in public it's so bad. Unfortunately I cut the tags etc off and would not have been able to return it. The overall shoulder cuts themselves were also uneven. The back panel, front panel, and arm sections are uneven as between left and right shoulder areas, leading to a shirt which sits crookedly, and has little pixy wing sections of cloth protruding upwards from the exterior of my shoulders. Basically, it looks stupid. I did take a punt with the business and bought a raglan shoulder shirt which is a good fit across the shoulders and upper arms. My very firm advice - DON'T buy the Arrival.

I’ve washed it twice to no avail. It looks like I’ve got little spikes on each shoulder. I would NOT wear this shirt in public the way it is. Quite frankly it looks ridiculous and the seams look crooked. I didn’t notice this until after removing tags and wearing, so I cannot return. It’s genuinely cut like a $10 shirt. Very, very disappointing. I tried to upload images but couldn’t on this review page.

sku_reviews.body: I've previously purchased an arrival t-shirt in the past (a few years ago) and absolutely loved it. Unfortunately, the new arrival t-shirt I order was completely different from my previous order. When making the order, I read some negative comments about the quality not feeling cheap, but completely disregarded these. I was under the impression these people were overly pedantic. I can 100% confirm the negative reviews are correct. Since buying my first arrival tee in the past, they've completely changed the manufacturing process The quality of the new arrival shirt is incredibly disappointing. The material feels incredibly cheap and thin. I feel like I could find a higher-quality shirt on Temu. The shirt also looks like it has shoulder pads in the most unnatural position. It looks like there's a coat hanger constantly sitting in them. On top of everything, the shirt just makes me feel uncomfortable/unaltered with my body. It's the exact opposite to every other Gym Shark shirt I've ever purchased. Just like my middle school teacher used to say... I'm not mad. I'm just disappointed

sku_reviews.author: Jiaheng
sku_reviews.title: Shadow Fit Feedback + Big Idea for Compression Inn
sku_reviews.body: I recently got the Shadow series top, and while I appreciate the design direction, there are some areas that could use improvement. The collar feels too loose — it doesn’t give that sharp, clean look I expected, especially compared to the same size in the Geo series, which fits perfectly. Also, the shirt length runs a bit long. Another thing I noticed is the chest panel’s inner fabric — it’s slightly rough and can rub against the skin during longer sessions, unlike the smoother material used in other lines. As for a broader idea — I think Gymshark could really shine by introducing limited compression pieces inspired by iconic anime characters, especially ones with muscular physiques and symbolic body markings. Take JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure for example — many protagonists have the signature star-shaped birthmark on their trapezius. Or in the upcoming Part 7 (Steel Ball Run), the main antagonist has distinctive chest and back scars that fans immediately recognize. This fandom overlaps massively with the fitness community. Berserk’s Guts has a branded mark on the neck — a symbol that’s actually quite popular among youth here in the UK (speaking as a Chinese student studying in the UK). Or even go classic — Fist of the North Star has the North Star bullet scars on the chest, which would look amazing on compression wear. These are just personal ideas, but if Gymshark ever integrates such elements, it would be incredibly exciting to see. You’d be tapping into culture and strength in one go.

sku_reviews.body: Hey everyone! I’ve been wearing Gymshark T-shirts for a while now, and I have to say, they’ve become a staple in my wardrobe—both for the gym and casual wear. Here’s my take: **What I Love:** 1. **Comfort Level**: The fabric is incredibly soft and breathable. Whether I’m lifting weights or running errands, these shirts feel amazing on my skin. 2. **Perfect Fit**: I love how the shirts hug my body without being too tight. The athletic fit gives me a confident, streamlined look, and they’re great for showing off progress at the gym. 3. **Moisture-Wicking Magic**: During intense workouts, I sweat a lot, but these shirts keep me dry and comfortable. No more feeling sticky or uncomfortable mid-session! 4. **Style Points**: The designs are sleek and modern. I especially love the minimalist logo—it’s subtle but still makes the shirt look premium. 5. **Durability**: Even after multiple washes, the colors haven’t faded, and the fabric hasn’t lost its shape. They’ve held up really well over time. **What Could Be Better:** 1. **Price Point**: They’re definitely on the pricier side, but I think the quality justifies the cost. Still, it’s something to keep in mind if you’re on a budget. 2. **Sizing**: I’ve noticed that some styles fit differently, so I always double-check the size guide before buying. 3. **Availability**: The popular colors and styles sell out FAST. I’ve missed out on a couple of designs I really wanted because I hesitated too long. **Final Thoughts:** Overall, I’m really happy with my Gymshark T-shirts. They’ve become my go-to for workouts, and I even wear them casually because they look so good. sku_reviews.title: Perfect Summer Fit
sku_reviews.body: Summer is starting in Texas and I was looking for some new options to stay cool in the summer. I'm 5'9" and about 175lbs so I got a large for a comfortable fit. The large sleeves feel better on the shoulders for my build than the medium. I'm happy with the look. It gives comfortable casual vibes and I pair it with shorts or Uniqlo Blended Linen pants. Most importantly, it feels great outdoors. We recently had an outdoor party where the temperature was 97° F and the shirt felt comfortable and it didn't build up with sweat. This was the number one thing I was hoping for so I'm happy with the performance and will probably get more in the future.

It's just palm trees against the sky, but there's something a little sinister about this landscape. Note: Uniqlo 20th Archive Ts are very much TRUE TO SIZE. Though I often wear XL Ts because they'll be too tight otherwise, this would have been real baggy on me in anything larger than an L.

And it’s less breathable than others I’ve purchased before, which makes it quite warm. Not pleased. Will be returning one of the two I bought because I unfortunately wore one and can’t return it.

I couldn't recommend this shirt more. I hope all of Uniqlo's clothes follow suit with this one.

I recommend the Medium size if the person wearing it is not afraid to have their stomach bulging out if they have a stomach that pushes out. sku_reviews.title: 5 Stars
sku_reviews.body: ★★★★★ I recently ordered the Fall Essentials Crew 6-Pack in a Large / Regular size, and I am thoroughly impressed with the quality and fit. The fabric feels remarkably soft and durable right out of the package, offering a clean, tailored look around the chest and arms without feeling overly tight or restrictive. The assortment of rich seasonal colors—including Charcoal, Heather Grey, Copper, Mosswood, Laguna, and Mulberry—makes it effortless to mix and match with jeans, jackets, or layering pieces for the cooler weather. The Large / Regular sizing hits the sweet spot, providing a classic, comfortable length that drapes just right. Even after going through the wash, the shirts have held up their softness and rich color remarkably well. If you are looking to upgrade your everyday rotation with reliable, great-fitting basics that punch well above their weight class, this 6-pack is an absolute home run.

sku_reviews.author: Christopher W.
sku_reviews.title: Great shirts by that’s it
sku_reviews.body: I was a returning True Classic customer, and while I really like their T-shirts, unfortunately that’s about where the positive experience ends. My first order arrived about a week later than expected, and my recent second order simply never showed up. True Classic eventually sent a replacement, but by then they were out of a plain white T-shirt included in my order. For a company whose entire business is selling T-shirts, not having a basic white tee in stock seems pretty unacceptable. I also tried ordering another six-pack of medium-tall, curved-hem shirts — three white and three black — but couldn’t complete the order. Their website doesn’t tell you something is out of stock; it simply won’t let you select it, leaving you wondering whether the site is broken or the product is unavailable. Customer service was also frustrating, with far too many AI/chatbot layers before reaching an actual person — who turned out to be someone from the fulfillment centre rather than True Classic itself. It’s unfortunate because I genuinely like the shirts, but this style of fitted T-shirt is available from plenty of companies now. Unreliable international shipping, poor inventory management and frustrating customer service mean I won’t be ordering from True Classic again.

The colors are great but we need more consistent and diverse choices in the tall sizes Last thing and I’ll shut up. TC also has sales with meaningful discounts. I have seen as much as 70% off. Great shirts, great fit, great price. Whats not to love.

Light weight and soft. The reason i gave them 4 stars has nothing to do with the quality of the shirts themselves, needless to say they are great quality shirts for sure. However the price for something like 6 plain white tshirts blows my mind a bit, and i got them on sale (which is the only reason I purchased them when i did). So im grateful i only paid an estimated $20 per-shirt at the discounted price they had on their site. I could maybe understand if they were something other than the plan white Tees. sku_reviews.author: Tod L.
sku_reviews.title: mostly good, a few qualms
sku_reviews.body: I have bought several True Classic shirts over the past five years, and mostly I am very happy with them. But I do notice differences in quality and in sizing from different batches. In this case, I had sized down from an XL to an L after losing some weight, so reordered a new shirt. Sizing is good except that the L is actually noticeably longer than the XL was. Not a deal breaker, but it would be nice to able to count on sizing from a brand. The other thing is that there is a noticeable "bump" in the shoulder seam -- hard to describe and again not a deal breaker, but I keep noticing it in the mirror and wish it wasn't there! Seems an issue with stitching.

sku_reviews.author: Miguel M.
sku_reviews.title: I'm a Large, got the XL, still not the right fit.
sku_reviews.body: These shirts are advertised as being tight around chest and arms and loose around the waist. FAR FROM IT. I'm usually a size Large on a regular box tee ( your standard Gildan T-shirt). I decided to order a 3 pack of the pocket tee in a size large with no worries since True Classic claims to sell shirts for dudes who want to have a more comfortable fit around their dad bods, muffin tops, etc.. I was pretty excited when I got my package in the mail, ripped it open, threw the shirt on and surprise surprise, the shirt was way tight, highlighting exactly what I wanted to hide, my muffin top, lol. I returned and exchanged them for the XL, and again, not very loose around the waist. I decided to keep the XL because honestly, I was in dyer need of a basic black t-shirt. That being said, unless you want to replace the gym with a True Classic shirt to appear to have bigger biceps, you are definitely better off buying a basic T-shirt from Target for a fraction of the price.

I know it's breathable because I've been wearing it all day and it was 85 degrees today in Arizona! It has a 60/40 cotton/polyester blend and is 50% thicker than the other dozen TC t-shirts I have in my closet. Yes, this shirt is called, "Heavyweight" but It doesn't feel overwhelming at all. The term "military grade" is very popular these days - well, I'm retired military and this shirt feels built to tough military standards. Looking at the stitching, I can see that it's been reinforced/thicker. I like that and believe it will hold up to anything that I throw at it. As with everything I've bought from TC, the fit is perfect. I love that they have a tall option for me. This shirt does not ride up when I sit down. I like the clean look of not having a pocket. I'll definitely be buying a few of these to add to my closet. This is the perfect tee to put under a flannel or sweatshirt in the fall or winter.

sku_reviews.author: Cody W.
sku_reviews.title: Great fit and still breathable
sku_reviews.body: Tall Heavyweight Tee This tee gets my stamp of approval. As a beefy guy, I have always felt a need to wear undershirts to keep the nips from poking through my shirt. With this being a heavier tee, but still breathable and flexible, I don’t feel the need to wear a shirt underneath. The tee length is perfect for those with longer torsos like myself. I work in the fire service and would love to get a few of these in Navy blue to wear on shift. TC, please start stocking more Navy colored tees since they are frequently out of stock 🙏.

I appreciate the heft of the TC heavyweight shirts, even in Florida, because they’re still soft, they feel more substantial and they’re not see through with the bright sun. You can’t go wrong with any TC product!

sku_reviews.author: Jonathan W.
sku_reviews.title: Black Heavyweight Curved Hem review
sku_reviews.body: The Good: Shirt feels very well made, feels soft and the fit is good, definitely better than the old Pima Ts. I usually wear an undershirt, but the material is thick and good enough quality that I think I'd be very comfortable without one with this shirt. This is my first curved hem shirt, wasn't sure how I'd feel about, but overall I like it. The Less Good: As you can see from the side view, when I lift my arm, a little bit too much is exposed, so it feels a tad short where it curves up, and I'd probably have to go with a Tall for these. This is more a location issue, but it's getting hot and humid where I live, so I may not pull this kind of shirt out as much as during the winter, and could see myself opting for the Classic or Active shirt instead during the summer Summary: Great shirt, I like it a lot except for the minors issues mentioned For reference, height ~6'1", weight ~195 lbs, shirt size L

sku_reviews.title: Very comfortable

sku_reviews.author: Nathan M.
sku_reviews.title: Great as always
sku_reviews.body: Heavy weight cotton tshirt fits great, loved the curved hem for a "sportier" look. fit is in line with the classic tee. Nice thicker material, feels very structured when wearing. Definitely recommend to any true classic fan or first time buyer.

sku_reviews.author: Craig G.
sku_reviews.title: Perfect Casual Office Shirt
sku_reviews.body: I'm loving the heavyweight curved hem crew. The fabric is soft, a little thicker than their regular crew, and the curved hem gives it a classy look while still being casual. Having the shirt be a little thicker gives it more structure with the way it hangs. I'm 6'0, 195 lbs, and the large is a perfect fit for my arms, body, and overall length. I'll be buying a few more for my days in the office.

sku_reviews.author: Buddy E.
sku_reviews.title: Great Fit With A Clean Curved Hem
sku_reviews.body: Love this black curved hem heavyweight tee. It kept its shape after washing and the fabric is super soft with a solid heavier feel compared to the classic tee. The curved hem gives it a clean modern look and I also own the straight hem heavyweight in navy and this one is just as good with a little extra style from the hem. For reference this is a size medium and I’m 5’9” and about 155 pounds.

sku_reviews.author: Ryan
sku_reviews.title: Very comfortable and surprisingly breathable
sku_reviews.body: I have been hesitant to try a heavy weight tee because I prefer light and breathable t-shirt material, more the athletic style, because I run hot but I decided to give the True Classic heavy weight crew a try because I have like everything I have tried from True Classic - and it did not disappoint. Is the tee heavy? Yes, it is but it is a comfortable heavy that sat on the body just right and it was still breathable and kept me cool even as I was running around all day it in. After the first hour, I didn't even notice the difference in weight or style, it just felt natural, like any other True Classic crew. The added bonus to this shirt is the curved hem (also a first for me) but it sat just right at the hips and pocket area allowing clean and clear access to my pockets for my phone and wallet but didn't ride up. Overall, the shirt is a win and I will definitely add more to my collection. 5 of 5 stars - highly recommend

sku_reviews.author: Earl C.
sku_reviews.title: New Favorite black tee
sku_reviews.body: They sent me this one to put through the ringer before the official drop. Black heavyweight cotton on a June day in Texas is usually a recipe for disaster, but this one completely surprised me. Took it out for a full day of shopping and unloading the car. The fit and collar held their shape perfectly all day without bagging out. The real shocker? Despite the premium weight, it’s incredibly breathable—I could actually feel the breeze cutting right through it in direct sunlight. Current customers, keep an eye out for this drop. It passes the test.

sku_reviews.title: Not what I was expecting

It’s softer not as heavy. The curve adds a little something more to the T-shirts. I just love this is something I would definitely wear in the late fall with the TC bomber jacket

sku_reviews.author: William
sku_reviews.title: Outstanding fit
sku_reviews.body: True Classic is so much more than just an "undershirt" company! I was incredibly impressed with the fit and feel of the Heavyweight Curved Hem Crew. Initially, I thought the curved hem looked a little unique, but after wearing it, it’s clear the folks at True Classic put a ton of thought into the cut. The sides are tailored perfectly high enough to let me get my phone in and out of my pocket with ease, while the front and back stay at just the right length without ever looking like a nightshirt. The fabric thickness is absolutely spot-on. It’s substantial enough to keep you comfortable on a cool night, yet breathable enough that I was able to comfortably wear it out during the early summer heat this past weekend. It is incredibly versatile, easily dressing up or down, and best of all—it has held up beautifully in the wash without any pilling or stretching. This one is a definite winner!

sku_reviews.title: Unfortunately it sucks
sku_reviews.body: Not true fit like they used to be. Seriously disappointed in the fit of these shirts. I was hoping the vneck would be as nice as the regular shirts but not even close. I’d return them if I could and it’s making me second guess true classics purchases in the future. None of us want to spend over 100$ on shirts that don’t fit. I have muscle and less belly fat than typical guy my age but I’m not a bodybuilder by any means. Arms are too tight, which is weird because I hate arm workouts, so I know I don’t have huge biceps where this should be a problem. The neck opening is way too big and I have traps. It’s like they made these shirts for fat people. Yeah I’m sure that’ll offend someone 🙄. Maybe that’s our standard XL shirt size now in the USA, which is also sad. It’s either true fit missed the mark or our standards have changed that much. Either way…I’m not spending anymore money on shirts that don’t fit at least somewhat normal. Size range below….its actually runs too large in the neck and stomach and way too tight for the arms.

sku_reviews.title: Reviewing the True Classics Active V-Neck: Fit, Fabric,
sku_reviews.body: I recently had the opportunity to try out the Active V-Neck from True Classics, and I wanted to share my thoughts. First and foremost, I have to commend the team at True Classics – the people I interacted with were genuinely nice and helpful, which always makes for a pleasant experience. Regarding the shirt itself, while I appreciate the effort and quality True Classics puts into their products, this particular v-neck wasn't quite the right fit for me. I personally found that the polyester material wasn't to my liking; I tend to prefer the pima cotton but it has not been in stock for some time. In terms of sizing, I ordered an XL, and it felt a bit big overall. Specifically, the arms were quite long, which made the fit less ideal for my preference. On a separate note, I was expecting a coupon for a previous review I submitted, but unfortunately, I never received that discount. I'm hoping that perhaps this review might lead to that working out. While this specific shirt didn't quite hit the mark for my personal taste and fit, I still had a positive interaction with the brand, and their customer service was excellent.

sku_reviews.author: James C.
sku_reviews.title: Honest Review
sku_reviews.body: The Active V-Neck Shirt isn’t something I’d normally choose for myself, but I was provided one in exchange for an honest review. The material feels great against the skin—lightweight and breathable. While the fabric is on the thinner side, I didn’t find that to be an issue. It held up well after washing and drying, with no noticeable shrinkage. If I was allowed a redo, I would have requested a large instead of an extra large, I felt the shirt was a tad too big. I’m truly grateful to TC for the opportunity to test another one of their products. sku_reviews.author: Paulo R.
sku_reviews.title: Bad
sku_reviews.body: ### ⭐ 1-Star Review Extremely disappointed with the quality of these shirts. My first set was a size large, and after **one quick wash, every single shirt shrank dramatically—from a large to what felt like an extra small.** I found that completely ridiculous. I had to return the entire order and reorder in extra large. Unfortunately, the replacement shirts were just as disappointing. The sizing is inconsistent, with some fitting much smaller than others, and the overall fit is not right. On top of that, **the colors noticeably faded after just one wash.** For the price, I expected much better quality and durability. Having to return my first order, reorder a different size, and still end up with shirts that don't fit properly and fade after one wash is incredibly frustrating. **Overall, horrible quality. I definitely will not purchase these shirts again.**

sku_reviews.author: Adam J. Z.
sku_reviews.title: Replied to feedback email- said I was not happy. And never heard back.
sku_reviews.body: Bought a pack of mediums curved hem. 2x each black, navy and military green all shrunk nearly a 1/2 size after a cold wash/low temp dry. Im what you'd call "skinny fat". I've got a beer drinkers tummy but im 5'9" and 165lbs. A slim fella. Half of the shirts out of the bag were stellar after a wash, and half made me feel like I bought a Small Shirt at a metal concert-boxy. Clingy. The opposite of what the company promotes. I recvd an email from True Classic, asking me to write them my feedback before I wrote for the internet at large. I shared my concern. On may 11th. Its now July 10. No reply from the customer service team. Bummer. I have ordered another mixed 10pk, but in Large size, despite the website HEAVILY suggesting I buy Med. I dont mind a slightly loose fit and I genuinely love the profile of the curved hem AND the fabric. Its so freaking comfy. Big big fan. I just wished all colorways washed/dried the same. Some shrunk a 1/2 -3/4 size after the 1st wash. Others only shrunk a smidge. Either way, I need to buy a size up to presume shrinkage post first-wash. And I did. My 1* is because the company REACHED OUT to me to avoid a negative review, then received a negative review in response, and proceeded to ghost my reply for 2months. Bummer.

sku_reviews.title: Finally, a Heavyweight Tee That Fits Shorter Guys
sku_reviews.body: At 5’6” and 178 lbs, finding a T-shirt with the right length can be challenging. The Heavyweight Short Tee gets the proportions right. I normally wear a Medium, but I went with a Large and was pleasantly surprised by the fit. It gives me a little extra room through the chest and midsection without looking oversized or baggy. What I like most is the shorter length. It hits at just the right spot when worn untucked and looks much more proportional on my frame. The heavyweight fabric feels substantial and high quality, holds its shape well, and is still very comfortable for everyday wear. If you’re 5’8” or under and find that regular T-shirts tend to run too long, this is definitely worth trying. I could wear a Medium for a more fitted look, but I’m really happy with the comfortable, relaxed fit of the Large.

sku_reviews.author: Brett N.
sku_reviews.title: A Long-Time Customer Let Down by Major Fit Changes
sku_reviews.body: I’m genuinely devastated by the changes and inconsistencies I’m now experiencing with True Classic. I was an early adopter of True Classic Tees because, at 6’7” and 250 lbs, finding a high-quality tee with a reliable fit has always been difficult. For years, the XL Tall was perfect — consistent cut, good length, and flattering proportions. It became my go-to. My previous order was the first time I noticed inconsistencies, with noticeably different fits depending on colour. While disappointing, I gave it the benefit of the doubt. I had since seen and read reviews suggesting changes to fit and quality following a shift in manufacturing to Asia, and I was genuinely hoping that wouldn’t be the case. Unfortunately, my most recent order of 3 white and 3 black tees confirmed my fears. The fit has clearly changed — and not for the better. All six tees are too short, too tight, and the hems sit awkwardly both front and back. They simply do not resemble the product I’ve trusted and purchased for years. My weight hasn’t changed. My body hasn’t changed. The cut has — massively. Living in Australia, it’s incredibly frustrating to be faced with the prospect of shipping returns back to the U.S. just to experiment with sizing, especially when the original product already worked perfectly. I honestly don’t understand why a brand would change the fit of a product that built its reputation on consistency. For a long-time customer, this is deeply disappointing.

sku_reviews.title: VERY dissapointed
sku_reviews.body: Long time customer here who has spent hundreds on T shirts with this company over the past several years. Have always ordered 2XL Tall Classic Curved Hem Crew Neck (straight hem when the curved were not available). Not only are these never in stock anymore, but the last pack I bought are completely different than what I have come to expect from previous orders with this company. As a person who has a long torso, I need Tall T Shirts, otherwise after 1 wash the bottom of the shirt barely falls below my belt line. After trying a pack of the Pima crews, which were TERRIBLE (boxy fit & they shrunk event when not using a dryer), I went back to my original order of Classic Tall 2XL curved hem crews. Unfortunately, these new curved hem crew necks are actually shorter than the classic tall straight hem crew necks i've ordered in the past. So much so that if I lift my arms above my head the bottom of the shirt comes up inches above my belly button. Something that doesnt happen with shirts I purchased from you years ago. I am not sure what has happened, im assuming you either changed overseas manufacturers or something with the existing manufacturer has changed. Either way, its very disappointing, Guess I have to go back on the hunt for another daily T-Shirt vendor.

sku_reviews.author: Andrew W.
sku_reviews.title: Finally, a V-Neck That Fits Like It Should
sku_reviews.body: I was skeptical at first, but True Classic nailed it. The fabric is soft without feeling flimsy, with just enough stretch to move comfortably throughout the day. The fit is the real standout—longer in the torso without looking oversized, and the sleeves actually sit right on the biceps instead of flaring out. It feels like it was made for my frame. This has already become a go-to piece in my rotation.

sku_reviews.author: Victoria R.
sku_reviews.title: Sizes Changed
sku_reviews.body: While I have always loved True Classic, they recently adjusted their sizing and I ordered a 6 pack of Mediums (like always) and they not only were too big, but a Large was in it as well. Since I tried them on, I no longer qualify for a return. So, if you are reordering, double check the sizing.

sku_reviews.body: My husband is 6’5 and I got a large-tall, but he’s very slender so I had to exchange for a medium-tall and it’s perfect. Its always so difficult finding shirts that he feels are long enough, but now that constant pulling on his shirt is a thing of the past!

sku_reviews.title: Excellent T-shirts

The quality too is everything I hoped for. To top it off, the first delivery went astray but the customer service team were very helpful and sent replacements immediately which arrived very promptly. I will definitely buy again and will enjoy exploring the range.

sku_reviews.author: Matthew B.
sku_reviews.title: Great shirts

sku_reviews.title: Good size, poor quality

As you can see in the picture, it already has weird colour alterations after just one time wearing them. Via their support I try to get contact, but after 3 attempts I am done. I've had multiple shirts from True Classic and was a fan of their products, but really puts a stamp on it... Be aware when buying this...

The quality and fit seems to have changed over the past year or two and in my opinion, its been an improvement.

I am going to Cancun so these shirts will be a life saver. Do not stop making these. If anything, offer more color options.

I’m a little bigger guy and it doesn’t pull up in the gym when I’m working out.

sku_reviews.author: Brad M.
sku_reviews.title: The Same Great Fitting Gym Shirt With a Modern Look
sku_reviews.body: I have been exclusively wearing TC active shirts at the gym for a couple of years now due to the perfect amount of breathability and length. I love the curved hem style with their classic tees. Now I get the benefits of both in one. My new favorite workout tee!

sku_reviews.author: Thomas C.
sku_reviews.title: Love the hem
sku_reviews.body: The curved hem is incredible. It elevates the active tee and I've been very happy with my purchase.

sku_reviews.author: Benjy R.
sku_reviews.title: Nice addition to the Active Tee fam
sku_reviews.body: First, some history: I have 3 Active tees that I've been wearing mostly as workout shirts for the past 3 years or so, and then another 4 that I've worn as casual tees or under-button-down-tees. Love 'em. This navy one's just like the others. In other words: excellent. It's a wee bit larger than my other ones (I'm 5'4", 155lb, and I wear a size M), but that may be because it hasn't been washed as much yet. I'm including photos of a heather blue one for fit comparison. The curved bottom is fun – not sure I care enough to seek it out, but it's a nice variation.

sku_reviews.author: Brad M.
sku_reviews.title: Blends their perfect curved hem look with the quality of an active tee
sku_reviews.body: True Classic active tees have essentially taken over my gym wardrobe over the last couple of years because of their fit and feel. While they are perfect, I was thrilled to see them release a curved hem version! I have recently been wearing their curved hem classic tees because I feel they give a more “upgraded” look. Now I get this same feeling in my gym shirts!

sku_reviews.author: Charles C.
sku_reviews.title: Love the Pima Cotton
sku_reviews.body: I spent a little bit extra and got the Pima cotton blend, and I am so pleased. The sheen and texture are amazing and people can’t believe it. It’s still 100% cotton because it’s just so smooth and silky (seriously). Also has some nice flex which I don’t understand how that’s possible. It’s just cotton, but it’s pretty nice. I’ve washed and dried it several times and it’s not pilling. My only ask is that you expand the color availability of the extra tall variants as they are limited. thank you!

And in the end they said they wouldn’t want this kind of t-shirt again, because it was comparable to Walmart quality and not worth the price.

sku_reviews.title: Exchange & Colour Difficulties. Piling Collars
sku_reviews.body: I built my own six pack of V-neck shirts and I erroneously clicked & chose one colour twice (my mistake). And boy do they ever make you pay the price! They make exchanges sound easy. But it was entirely painful with their horrendous automated email system. As if that isn’t tedious enough…then they actually wait to receive your return before they will even send out your corrected replacement. Unfortunately for me, it wasn’t until THEN that they told me the colour I wanted wasn’t even available! WTF? This is about the third time I’ve ordered shirts from True Classic. I enjoy the styling, however I am tired of the piling around the collars. The fading. The easy staining. At this price point, there is no excuse for the quality to not be steps above your standard Gildan/Fruit Of The Loom shirts already out there…for far less.

sku_reviews.body: I purchased the Heavyweight Crew T-Shirts expecting a noticeably higher-quality T-shirt, especially given the price. Unfortunately, I was disappointed from the first time I tried them on. Right out of the package, they didn’t look or feel much better than a good-quality T-shirt that I could buy for about a third of the price. I was hoping the heavier fabric and overall fit would make them feel more premium, but that just wasn’t my experience. What was even more disappointing was how they looked after just one wash. The shirts looked noticeably worse, to the point that I don’t even wear them casually anymore. They’ve basically become shirts that I only wear around the house. I don’t mind paying more for a quality product, but when I do, I expect the quality, fit and durability to justify the higher price. Unfortunately, these shirts did not meet those expectations.

sku_reviews.author: Don L.
sku_reviews.title: Not Impressed
sku_reviews.body: I purchased the Heavyweight Crew T-Shirts expecting a noticeably higher-quality T-shirt, especially given the price. Unfortunately, I was disappointed from the first time I tried them on. Right out of the package, they didn’t look or feel much better than a good-quality T-shirt that I could buy for about a third of the price. I was hoping the heavier fabric and overall fit would make them feel more premium, but that just wasn’t my experience. What was even more disappointing was how they looked after just one wash. The shirts looked noticeably worse, to the point that I don’t even wear them casually anymore. They’ve basically become shirts that I only wear around the house. I don’t mind paying more for a quality product, but when I do, I expect the quality, fit and durability to justify the higher price. Unfortunately, these shirts did not meet those expectations.

sku_reviews.title: Sizing issues

Out of the bag perfect fit, but after washing, they shrunk considerably, to the point I can't wear them. The heavy weight looked intriguing though, so I ordered a 3 pack of black in XL this time. Side Note, I wanted the blue, but you can only get in it a pack of Black, Blue and White, and I never wear white, so I decided with the black only. Either way, out of the box, way to big, but washed them, and didn't shrink much, or at all, so still too big. Even the Polo that isn't Heavy weight didn't shrink much, so that is too big. So kind of at a loss with this. Not sure why the size large shrunk so much, but XL is now too big. I now have 9 shirts from 2 orders that are either too big or too small.

sku_reviews.title: Heavier Duty Tee, Same TC Fit

They fit similar to a traditional TC shirt, so it doesn’t feel too boxy like other brands. The material is super soft for the thickness of it. Highly recommended!!

sku_reviews.author: Paul S.
sku_reviews.title: Black Heavyweight Crew
sku_reviews.body: I was chosen to product test the Heavyweight Tee. After trying it out today at work, here are my thoughts At first glance you can see that it is definitely heavier material than the normal tees that I have purchased from TC. Although it is heavier material, it isn’t really noticeable while wearing it. Today was an unusually warm day for us here in PA, and I wasn’t overheating or anything like that. The fit is similar to the other tees. Snug in the places that are flattering yet roomy enough where it doesn’t feel constricting. For reference, I am 5’8” and 215 lbs and this is an XL. All in all, this there is well made and very comfortable. Highly recommend!!

sku_reviews.author: Hendra T.
sku_reviews.title: Navy Heavyweight Crew
sku_reviews.body: First impression: Right out of the package, the fabric feels noticeably thicker than your typical t-shirt, but not stiff. It has a solid, structured feel without being uncomfortable. The black color is deep and clean, and the overall look is simple and versatile. Fit and feel: This is where it stands out. The shirt fits well through the shoulders and chest without being tight, and it falls naturally around the midsection. It doesn’t cling, which I appreciate. The sleeves sit nicely on the arms, giving it a more put-together look than a basic tee. Length is also right—long enough to stay tucked if needed, but still looks good untucked. How I’ve been wearing it: Mostly casual—paired with khaki shorts and slides, like in the photos. It works great for everyday wear, running errands, or just being comfortable at home. I can also see it easily pairing with jeans or chinos if you want to dress it up slightly. Comfort and performance: Even though it’s a heavyweight fabric, it’s still breathable. I didn’t feel overheated wearing it indoors or outside. It holds its shape well throughout the day—no stretching out or looking worn after a few hours. Compared to other t-shirts: I normally wear standard cotton tees, and this definitely feels like a step up. Most regular shirts either feel too thin or lose structure quickly. This one keeps a clean silhouette and feels more durable. It gives off a more intentional, polished look without trying too hard. What I liked most: The balance between structure and comfort. It feels substantial, but still easy to wear all day. Also, the fit; it’s simple, but flattering without being tight. Would I recommend it? Yes. If you’re looking for a t-shirt that looks a little sharper than your average tee and holds up better over time, this is a solid choice. It’s the kind of shirt you can wear regularly and still feel put together.

sku_reviews.author: Taylor D.
sku_reviews.title: A new staple in the wardrobe
sku_reviews.body: My husband used to be a die hard Carhartt fan because of the heavy weight material and it helped not getting solder all over his other shirts. There was a clear distinction between work and fun shirts. Although he didn’t like how stiff those shirts were. When TC launched their heavy weight tees, it was a done deal and now that they offer them without a pocket which my husband prefers, we are now updating his entire work attire.

sku_reviews.author: Dakota D.
sku_reviews.title: Phenomenal Shirt!
sku_reviews.body: This shirt is a nice mix in to the classic tees in the wardrobe! It's a little heavier with its material but it is very comfortable and moves with you very well. May be a little hot on summer days if you run warm like I do but it will not deter me from wearing it with how overall comfortable it is!

sku_reviews.author: Jaron H.
sku_reviews.title: Great Heavyweight!
sku_reviews.body: I have been looking at the heavyweights for a while now but never liked the idea of having a pocket on them - I was very glad to see that I can get them without a pocket now! Just for fun, I took my TC Classic (well, my newer one that it is better condition anyway!) and compared it to the TC Heavyweight. The material on the heavyweight is notably thicker but what really got me was how much better the stitching is! My photos don't really do it justice, but the stitching is noticeably tighter and stronger. One interesting thing here is that I got an XL instead of a Large. Immediately, my wife noticed that the sleeves don't hug the arms like the L (we both like that about the L). On the flip side, the length it much better on the XL. Will be curious to see how it looks after a couple of washes! Maybe next time I will have to try and Large-Tall and see if I get the best of both worlds? Overall, I'm very happy with it so far and would highly recommend it! Great build, good field, and overall good fit!

sku_reviews.author: Joel B.
sku_reviews.title: Great Shirt
sku_reviews.body: I received the heavyweight tee in the mail yesterday. I'm not normally a white tee kind of guy but this will definitely be in my daily rotation after trying it on It fits very well just like the normal tees, especially in the shoulders and arms and the material feels great on the skin. Still seems to breath well even with the thicker material. Definitely better suited for colder weather though in my opinion. The quality is amazing as you have come to expect from True Classic. Will definitely be buying more colors when these particular shirts become available on the app and site!

sku_reviews.author: John Q.
sku_reviews.title: A Working Man's Crew -
sku_reviews.body: This shirt is exceptionally nice! It feels very soft to the touch. I know it's breathable because I've been wearing it all day and it was 85 degrees today in Arizona! It has a 60/40 cotton/polyester blend and is 50% thicker than the other dozen TC t-shirts I have in my closet. Yes, this shirt is called, "Heavyweight" but It doesn't feel overwhelming at all. The term "military grade" is very popular these days - well, I'm retired military and this shirt feels built to tough military standards. Looking at the stitching, I can see that it's been reinforced/thicker. I like that and believe it will hold up to anything that I throw at it. As with everything I've bought from TC, the fit is perfect. I love that they have a tall option for me. This shirt does not ride up when I sit down. I like the clean look of not having a pocket. I'll definitely be buying a few of these to add to my closet. This is the perfect tee to put under a flannel or sweatshirt in the fall or winter.

sku_reviews.author: Richmond R.
sku_reviews.title: Heavyweight Tee Thoughts....
sku_reviews.body: The Heavyweight.... This is your "workhorse" tee. It has a structured, boxy silhouette that feels more substantial and durable. It’s less about showing off the physique and more about a clean, uniform look that doesn't cling. Pros Structure: The thicker collar and heavier fabric stay flat and don’t "bacon" or curl after a few washes. Forgiving Fit: It hides undershirts or skin texture well, creating a smooth line from the shoulder down. Durability: This feels like a shirt that can handle a lot of wear and tear without thinning out. Cons Heat: Might be a bit much for a high-humidity day. Movement: The sleeves have more "stiffness" to them, which gives a more traditional, rugged look rather than a modern athletic one. Size is a Large.

sku_reviews.author: Matt M.
sku_reviews.title: Another Level
sku_reviews.body: This shirt feels like it’s from a different company - the material is softer & (obviously) heavier than the traditional tee. I’ve always been a bit jealous of my wife - she has really nice quality tees that can be worn in pretty much any situation. Well now so do I! The heavyweight tee isn’t an undershirt - it’s the show. For reference, I’m about 6’1” | 260lbs, and I got an XL. The fit is great, comfortable through the chest & arms, not tight around the belly, and a good length that doesn’t pull up when raising my arms.

sku_reviews.author: Joshua P.
sku_reviews.title: New Favorite Shirt
sku_reviews.body: I absolutely LOVE this shirt. From the moment I put it on I knew it was going to be one of my favorite t-shirts that I own. The material is very soft and smooth. The shirt is extremely comfortable and feels light and breathable. The fit is amazing both in the chest and arms as well as the length. It’s not tight to the body either which I like. What I love most about it though is the versatility. You can wear it just as an everyday shirt but it also has the adaptability to be a date night or night out option with some nice pants or shorts. I definitely plan on getting more colors in these.

sku_reviews.author: Hendra T.
sku_reviews.title: Incredibly Soft with a Premium Feel
sku_reviews.body: This Pima T-Shirt exceeded my expectations. The fabric is incredibly smooth and soft, and you can immediately tell it’s made with quality materials. The fit is clean and stylish without feeling too tight, making it easy to wear for just about any occasion. It looks great on its own with shorts or jeans and can easily be dressed up with a jacket. After wearing it all day, it remained comfortable and kept its shape. If you’re looking for a premium everyday t-shirt that combines comfort, quality, and style, this is an excellent choice.

sku_reviews.title: PIMA IS ABCK

sku_reviews.author: Mike Z.
sku_reviews.title: Pima cotton
sku_reviews.body: I was sent the True Classic Pima Cotton T-shirt to test and provide an honest review. For reference, I’m 6’0” and 230 pounds, and I actually sized down to a Large, which ended up being the right choice. The fabric is incredibly soft and has a premium feel right out of the package. The fit is exactly what I look for—it hugs the upper chest and arms without feeling restrictive, while remaining forgiving around the waist instead of clinging to every curve. It’s a versatile shirt that looks just as good with jeans and sneakers as it does layered under a sport coat or paired with chinos for a more polished look. Thank you for selecting me to review the new Pima cotton.

sku_reviews.author: Christopher A.

sku_reviews.body: I've gone through so many basic white t-shirts trying to find one that fits right and doesn't feel cheap. The Pima cotton on this one is a game-changer. It's super soft, drapes really nicely, and most importantly, it isn't see-through at all. Will definitely be stocking up.

sku_reviews.author: James M.

It fits perfectly around the arms and chest but gives a little room around the stomach. Holds its shape great after washing, too.

sku_reviews.author: Jim E.
sku_reviews.title: Short active tee

This shirt seems to be cut just slightly larger than the classic tee but not so much that you would need to downsize. I have not washed it yet but being it seems to a larger cut a little shrinkage will not matter. Time will tell how durable it will be. As of now I would give this shirt an 8-9 out of ten. Should this shirt wear as well as the classic cut it will be a definitely 10 out of 10.

The first picture is the shirt out of the wrapper against a well worn standard length, and the second one is after a couple of washes. Overall: I would happily buy this shirt. sku_reviews.author: William
sku_reviews.title: Plan for slight shrink
sku_reviews.body: The Bottom Line: Just hit the buy button. It is a highly comfortable, quality everyday T-shirt, but you need to be mindful of the sizing and wash shrinkage. ​Fit & Sizing I typically wear a medium, but I ordered a large this time. Out of the package, the large was admittedly bigger than I should have gotten. However, after the first wash, it shrank a bit and ended up fitting perfectly. I am actually very glad I didn't order my usual medium. That being said, because I sized up to accommodate the shrinkage, it doesn't quite have that signature tight fit around the arms and chest that True Classic advertises—the medium likely would have delivered better on those specific features. The overall length is great; it sits appropriately at my belt, does not ride up, and never shows my stomach. ​Fabric & Quality The material is comfortable, almost cozy. It is not overly thick or heavyweight, making it the perfect thickness for everyday wear. You can easily wear this out and about and not feel like you are just wearing an undershirt. ​Durability & Details The shirt held both its shape and its rich navy color perfectly through the wash. It feels like a solid value for the price, especially since the quality control is on point—the shirt is tagless and arrived with absolutely no loose threads. ​Final Thoughts I am giving this 4 out of 5 stars. It would absolutely be a 5-star shirt if it didn't shrink in the wash. If you account for the shrinkage when picking your size, you will get a fantastic, comfortable shirt.

sku_reviews.author: Greg R.
sku_reviews.title: Keep Perfecting the Pima!
sku_reviews.body: The Pima Cotton Blend, Curved Hem crew feels like TC’s elevated staple that’s here to stay. I chose to size up from normal given the history of shrinkage in the original Pima iteration. The fabric feels great and moves around the body nicely. The material better avoids those awkward snags than most shirts of this thickness can tend to have, without necessarily feeling like a “heavier shirt”. That familiar snug around the chest is present. The arms are a tad looser than the typical TC cut, but still flattering to the arms with decent range of motion. Maybe a little too much room in the torso for my liking at this size up, which probably means my normal size would feel perfect. The length on this size feels great at my height, so I’m curious as to how my normal size would fall, even with the curved hem. Overall, a good iteration on the Pima and one I hope to see TC more regularly evolve and gain feedback on to continue making it that much better and consistently available.

sku_reviews.author: Joe
sku_reviews.title: Great Shirt for an Elevated Look
sku_reviews.body: Overall I am very happy with the shirt. When it first came, it felt slightly larger than I expected, but after a wash it fit as I would expect a True Classic shirt to fit. Feels slightly tighter on the arms and chest and a little more forgiving in the torso. The feel of the fabric is very nice. Not overly soft but comfortable. Because it’s heavyweight, the fabric has a more substantial feel. I could see myself wearing this on cooler summer evenings and into the fall. It’s not a shirt for 80 degree and up days, but I don’t think it’s meant for that. This is not a tuck in shirt, in my opinion and it doesn’t need to be with the curved hem, which is subtle but adds a nice little higher-end feel. This shirt will have a place in my standard rotation. Length is just where it needs to be as I am on the tall end for this size, but I like where it lands. I wound not want it any shorter and if I were any taller, I’d want to either go up a size or get a tall.

That said, as I mentioned after a quick wash on delicate and low heat dry as I do with all my clothes this fits perfectly. I’ve never owned clothing in Pima cotton material and this thing is like butter, ultra soft and breathes well. The black is a true black if you know what I mean. I feel this will hold up to fading better than regular cotton. I’ve already ordered the grove colorway as that is how impressed I am with this shirt. Hopefully more colors come soon. I feel I can’t go back to normal cotton now. This belongs on a hanger and not folded in a drawer. I’m super picky so I would note any faults if found them. I’m a big fan of the TC active wear and this is on par with that comfort and feel just a tad thicker. Easily a shirt you can dress up or down. I travel quite a bit so I’m gonna give this a go as my airline shirt. Order this and you will not regret it.
